name: voice-marker
description: Mark paragraphs with P(slop) and rewrite them in Dan's voice via a stylebot sidecar (ai-style/dan-style serve)

commands.title: Voice Marker: Rewrite in Dan's Voice

voiceMarker.command.markdownDescription: Sidecar command as argv, e.g. `["uv", "run", "--project", "/path/to/blog", "ai-style", "serve", "--detector-model", "_models/voice-clf"]`. Empty = extension stays dormant (set this per workspace, not globally).

voiceMarker.cwd.description: Working directory for the sidecar spawn (so relative --detector-model paths resolve). Empty = first workspace folder.

voiceMarker.thresholds.description: Ascending P(slop) bucket edges; a paragraph below the first edge gets no mark. Calibrate to your detector's score distribution (quantiles), not equal-width bins.

voiceMarker.minChars.description: Skip paragraphs shorter than this (short texts score noisily).

voiceMarker.debounceMs.description: Idle time after an edit before rescoring.

voiceMarker.bestOf.description: Candidates to sample per rewrite (the sidecar needs a styler armed — dan-style serve, or ai-style serve with --backend).
